Spinach is a leafy vegetable that grows in a dark-green rosette about 8 to 10 inches
across.  The leaves may be flat or curly, depending on the variety.  Cooked spinach
has a pungent, earthy flavor and can have a mushy 
texture; raw spinach is milder and crisp.
